sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reaffirmed, not raised, and management explicitly cited a volatile operating environment with increasing inflationary pressures and persistently low consumer sentiment. The Q2 top-line guidance of -3% to -5% growth indicates a sequential deterioration from Q1's -0.4% organic decline, and the company highlighted a 100 basis point SNAP headwind beginning this quarter. Despite some positive market share trends and strong cash flow, the cautious forward outlook and reaffirmed (not raised) guidance justify a mildly bearish score.

summary.revenue: Net sales increased 0.8% to $6,047 million; Organic Net Sales decreased 0.4%.
summary.eps: Diluted EPS increased 13.6% to $0.67; Adjusted EPS decreased 6.5% to $0.58.
summary.guidance: Reaffirmed FY2026 outlook: Organic Net Sales down 1.5% to down 3.5%; Constant Currency Adjusted Operating Income down 14% to down 18%; Adjusted EPS in range of $1.98 to $2.10; Free Cash Flow Conversion approximately 100%. Q2 revenue growth expected between -3% and -5%.
summary.margin: Gross profit margin increased 230 bps to 36.7%; Adjusted Gross Profit Margin decreased 30 bps to 34.1%.
key_risks: SNAP headwinds (approximately 100 basis point impact on Organic Net Sales)
Volume/mix declines in coffee, cold cuts, and Indonesia
Incremental investments of $600 million pressuring near-term profitability
Lapping lower variable compensation in 2025 (300 basis point headwind)
Nonrecurring gross margin gains (40-50 bps) will not recur
Q2 revenue growth expected between -3% and -5%
key_opportunities: Improving market share trends, particularly in Taste Elevation (81% of categories holding or gaining share)
U.S. mix-adjusted share loss reduced to 30 bps year-to-date from 90 bps at start of last year
Strong Free Cash Flow ($0.8 billion, up 58.9%)
New product launches (Power Mac & Cheese, Capri Sun Hydrate, Philadelphia Lactose Free)
Away-from-home channel opportunities with Heinz brand
International growth, especially Emerging Markets (Organic Net Sales +3.8%)
